method: Fifty genuinely distinct registered source areas were checked once at exact-model level, then each atomic field received a field-specific acceptance or rejection application. Public XHS was limited to search-engine indexes under shared-runtime coordination; no new XHS capture, browser-profile bypass, login, CAPTCHA or security-verification action was attempted.
identity_note: The current exact manufacturer page and current catalog identify ACE III 105 as a distinct CNY 12,999 complete bike; retailer and owner builds were not substituted for the factory configuration.
